verdict.oneLineSummary: Gated by Azure AD multi-tenant configuration, Enterprise Admin Consent walls, and MPN publisher verification.

twoClocks.anyUserCanConnect: 3–6 weeks (Microsoft Cloud Partner Program verification + Enterprise admin consent)

cost: Setup free. Publisher verification requires an active Dun & Bradstreet (D-U-N-S) business registration.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent read emails and calendar events across Microsoft 365 organizations?
capabilityCheck.detail: Microsoft Graph has comprehensive APIs (Mail.ReadWrite, Calendars.ReadWrite). The wall is ENTERPRISE GOVERNANCE: Most corporate Microsoft 365 tenants block users from authorizing non-verified multi-tenant apps until an IT administrator grants tenant-wide consent.

prerequisites: An Azure / Microsoft Entra ID tenant with admin rights
A verified Microsoft Partner Network (MPN) ID for Publisher Verification
D-U-N-S business registry matching company domain

steps.text: Open Microsoft Entra admin center (portal.azure.com) → App registrations → New registration.

fields.name: Supported account types
fields.note: MUST select 'Accounts in any organizational directory (Any Microsoft Entra ID tenant - Multitenant)'. Default single-tenant will block external users.

steps.text: Add Microsoft Graph Delegated Permissions under API permissions.

fields.name: Admin consent required permissions
fields.note: Avoid scopes with 'Admin Consent Required: Yes' (like Mail.ReadWrite.All) unless building internal tooling.

steps.text: Link MPN ID under 'Branding & properties' for Publisher Verification.

fields.name: MPN ID
fields.note: Required to remove the alarming 'Unverified Publisher' blue warning banner during login.

scopes.note: Sign in and read user profile

blockers.issue: Enterprise Admin Consent: In most corporate tenants, standard employees will hit 'Need admin approval' and cannot connect without an IT ticket.
blockers.workaround: Provide an Admin Consent onboarding link (`/adminconsent`), or use Composio Managed Auth.

blockers.issue: Publisher verification requires matching company registration with Dun & Bradstreet, taking 2–4 weeks through legal/IT channels.
blockers.workaround: Test with unverified status in developer sandboxes while legal processes MPN paperwork.

composio.recommendation: Microsoft Entra publisher verification and admin consent hurdles make Composio Managed Auth extremely attractive for rapid deployment.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Entra requires verified publisher status for multi-tenant apps to avoid warning banners, and tenants enforce admin consent by default.
evidence.label: SOURCED
